***Infinite Craft*** is a 2024 [sandbox game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sandbox_game "Sandbox game") developed by [Neal Agarwal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neal_Agarwal "Neal Agarwal"). In the game, players combine various [AI-generated](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_artificial_intelligence "Generative artificial intelligence") elements to form new ones. It was released on January 31, 2024, on Agarwal's website neal.fun, followed by [iOS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IOS "IOS") on April 30, 2024, and [Android](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_\(operating_system\) "Android (operating system)") on May 21, 2024. The game received wide popularity and a positive reception from critics, who praised the game's unpredictable nature. When it was released, it was very popular on [Twitch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitch_\(service\) "Twitch (service)") and [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube").

## Gameplay

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Infinite_Craft&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Gameplay")\]

[![Gameplay screenshot](//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/a/aa/Gameplay_screenshot_of_Infinite_Craft%2C_2024.png/250px-Gameplay_screenshot_of_Infinite_Craft%2C_2024.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Gameplay_screenshot_of_Infinite_Craft,_2024.png)

In *Infinite Craft*, the player can craft various elements using previous ones gained.

*Infinite Craft* is a [web-based](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Browser_game "Browser game") [sandbox game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sandbox_game "Sandbox game"). The main aspect of the game are elements, which represent an idea, object, or concept. The player starts with the [four classical elements](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classical_element "Classical element") (water, fire, wind, and earth) and uses various combinations of two elements to form new ones. For example, Plant and Smoke produces Incense,[\[1\]](#cite_note-1) which creates Perfume when combined with itself.[\[2\]](#cite_note-RPS-2)[\[3\]](#cite_note-3) All elements crafted by the player are saved to the sidebar, where the player can also search for crafted elements by their name.[\[4\]](#cite_note-PCG-4)

The game uses [Llama 2 and Llama 3.1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Llama_\(language_model\) "Llama (language model)"), a [large language model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model "Large language model"), to create new elements and assign emojis.[\[2\]](#cite_note-RPS-2)[\[5\]](#cite_note-DES-5)[\[6\]](#cite_note-EUG-6) When a player combines two elements on the website, the game checks from its database if these two elements have already been combined before—if they have not, the generative AI creates a new element which is then saved to the database.[\[4\]](#cite_note-PCG-4)[\[7\]](#cite_note-7) This is done to reduce repeated queries, and to ensure that the same pair of elements always outputs the same result for all players.[\[8\]](#cite_note-NYT-8) If a player is the first person to discover an element, the game labels it as a "First Discovery".[\[2\]](#cite_note-RPS-2)[\[4\]](#cite_note-PCG-4)

As the game can theoretically go forever and has a potentially infinite number of possible elements, there is no defined goal. Players have created databases of recipes, and some YouTubers have attempted to [speedrun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speedrun "Speedrun") the game.[\[8\]](#cite_note-NYT-8) Agarwal has said that Llama is "not quite as smart" as [ChatGPT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ChatGPT "ChatGPT").[\[4\]](#cite_note-PCG-4) A content filter is in place that filters offensive results, but there are still occasionally incoherent results, which players find amusing.[\[8\]](#cite_note-NYT-8) The longest theoretically possible element in Infinite Craft is 320 characters long, because every element in the game is limited to twenty Llama 2 tokens, and the maximum possible length of a token is 16 characters.\[*[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")*\]

## Development and release

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Infinite_Craft&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Development and release")\]

[![Neal Agarwal is sitting.](//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/57/Neal_working.png/250px-Neal_working.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Neal_working.png)

Agarwal working on *Infinite Craft*

*Infinite Craft* was made by Neal Agarwal, a software developer based in [New York City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_City "New York City"). In an interview, Agarwal said that he has been developing games since the age of nine and that he thinks "There should be more people creating fun stuff on the web." After enrolling at [Virginia Tech](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virginia_Tech "Virginia Tech") in 2016, he created neal.fun, a collection of small browser games about various topics, most of which he created during lectures. One of the site's first games, *Spend Bill Gates' Money*, received attention with over 80 million page views. The site was again popularized when Agarwal released *[The Password Game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Password_Game "The Password Game")*, a game in which the player needs to pick a password that abides by increasingly unusual and complicated rules, on June 27, 2023.[\[9\]](#cite_note-BSI-9)

Development of *Infinite Craft* was announced on January 16, 2024.[\[10\]](#cite_note-10) The game was made available on the website on January 31, two weeks after the announcement.[\[8\]](#cite_note-NYT-8) [Mobile apps](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mobile_app "Mobile app") were later developed and released on [App Store](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/App_Store_\(Apple\) "App Store (Apple)") and [Google Play](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Play "Google Play") on April 30, 2024, and May 21, 2024, respectively.[\[11\]](#cite_note-11)[\[12\]](#cite_note-12)[\[13\]](#cite_note-13)

The game became popular on the internet shortly upon release. According to Agarwal, the game received over thirty thousand views in the first month[\[14\]](#cite_note-14) and over 300 million recipes are created each day.[\[8\]](#cite_note-NYT-8) This has caused the website's servers to overload, and Agarwal had to petition the hosting service provider to increase its [bandwidth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bandwidth_\(computing\) "Bandwidth (computing)").[\[4\]](#cite_note-PCG-4)

## Reception

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Infinite_Craft&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Reception")\]

The game received positive reviews upon release. Christian Donlan of *[Eurogamer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurogamer "Eurogamer")* compared *Infinite Craft* to one of his [lucid dreams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucid_dream "Lucid dream"), explaining that an element "always \[runs\] away" when the player tries to figure out what elements to combine,[\[6\]](#cite_note-EUG-6) while journalist [Kieran Press-Reynolds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kieran_Press-Reynolds "Kieran Press-Reynolds"), writing for *[The New York Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_New_York_Times "The New York Times")* stated it was "like peering into an A.I.'s brain", adding that the game's nonsensical nature "adds to the allure".[\[8\]](#cite_note-NYT-8) *[Rock Paper Shotgun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rock_Paper_Shotgun "Rock Paper Shotgun")*'s Graham Smith praised how the game was "glorious, time-stealing fun to try", commenting how "the real joy comes" when a player finds a simple way to create an element.[\[2\]](#cite_note-RPS-2)

## Screenshots

![neverquest gameplay](screenshots/f4506a354761f20944c664a3c54b90c74776e9d0a391f13a1c0b85ad0dc97fee.png)

Inspected full combat frame at Coast of the Screams stage 33: player panel with health 431/463 DODGED, stamina, attack/recovery timers, six-stat grid, Titanium Halberd / Tasset of Destitution / Alchemical Wall gear, Butchery mastery 69/78; monster panel for Blighted Scoundrel 135/696 with attack timer and ailment meters; essence 864/1,444 progress. ## Play

- Open https://kitnato.github.io/neverquest/ in a browser (or npm install, npm start, then http://localhost:5173).
- In the wilderness, choose attack to engage the lurking monster and trade automatic blows on your attack rate while managing health and stamina.
- Retreat to disengage, or fight until one side dies; loot essence and items on kills, watch for boss monsters every few stages.
- When the stage is cleared, collect loot, rest, and travel to the caravan to trade with the merchant and hire crew (medic, tailor, blacksmith, fletcher, mercenary, alchemist, occultist, witch).
- Spend essence on attribute ranks, train skills via the mercenary, craft gear via blacksmith/fletcher, socket gems, expand encumbrance via tailor, and complete journal conquests/routines/triumphs.
- Death rebirths you a stage lower keeping items and power level but losing unspent essence — scavenge your corpse; retire later for a fresh start with mighty perks toward the true ending.

## Mechanics

- Automatic attack-rate combat with retreat/disengage, recovery lockout, stamina exhaustion and dodge/block/parry mitigation
- Health/stamina reserves with regeneration, ailments (bleeding, blight, poison, stagger, stun, thorns) and deflection
- 8 essence-bought attributes (agility, dexterity, endurance, perception, speed, strength, vigor, vitality) raising power level
- Melee (piercing/slashing/blunt/two-handed), ranged with distance/range, shields with stagger, armor protection and burden costs
- Skills, masteries (butchery, cruelty, finesse, marksmanship, resilience, might) and traits/retirement perks
- Wilderness stages with progress meters, rage/frenzy, bosses dropping gems and relics
- Caravan crew economy: merchant buyback, medic healing/bandages, tailor encumbrance, blacksmith/fletcher crafting, alchemist transmutation, occultist respec, witch potions
- Inventory with weight/encumbrance, knapsack, gear comparison indicators, gem socketing, relic infusions, munitions
- Quest journal with conquest/routine/triumph classes and completion bonuses, plus death corpse-scavenging and phylactery resurrection

Build neverquest, an irreverent text-based incremental action RPG as a React/TypeScript web app: automatic attack-rate wilderness combat with stamina, ailments and boss stages; essence loot economy; caravan hub with merchant, medic, tailor, blacksmith, fletcher, mercenary, alchemist, occultist and witch; deep attributes/skills/masteries/traits/quests/retirement progression with indefinite stages and a true ending; clean monochrome Bootstrap UI using game-icons.net icons, deployable to GitHub Pages.

# How to Play Infinite Craft

## How to Play Infinite Craft

The best way to start Infinite Craft is to get the ball rolling by messing with the currently available elements in your inventory. The game’s layout is separated into two different main screens where on the left side, you’ll have your infinite workspace, and on the right, you’ll have your list of elements that you can use to create new items along with Discoveries and a sorting menu.

### Click and Drag

All you need in this game is a working mouse! From the right side of the screen, you’ll click and drag the elements over to the infinite moving space on the left side. For example, when selecting Water, you can drag it onto the left side, and by letting go, it’ll plop itself into space.

Then, you can select the same element (or a different one) by clicking and dragging it onto the left side and letting go of the element on top of the one you previously placed. This action combines the two elements to create something new. By using both the elements that are provided in the game and what new discoveries you unlock, you can discover all types of different items that can be created in Infinite Craft.

![How to Play Infinite Craft Guide Image.jpg](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7)

Notes to keep in mind is that sometimes when you are combining elements, it is possible to work backwards to a solution. When you are adding more basic types of items, Infinite Craft can take the combination as a subtraction instead of combining elements.

**Such as:**

-   **Pirate + Pirate = Pirate Ship**
-   **Pirate + Pirate Ship = Captain**

While the combination of two different Pirate elements created a Pirate Ship; by combining Pirate and Pirate Ship, the game subtracted the common theme and created a Captain. If there’s an item that you are hoping to make, remember that if you do not have the elements in your wheelhouse to create something, you can also work backward to get the desired base elements.

### Short Cuts

Given Infinite Craft’s simplicity, there aren’t many keys to worry about when combining elements! But the more elements you get, the more items start to get a little out of hand on your discovery page. Here are some easy shortcuts to help cut down on the click-and-drag when you’re working on a thread of different items.

-   **Left-Click: Select the Item/Element**
-   **Double-Click: Copies the Item/Element Selected**
-   **Right-Click: Deletes the Item/Element Selected**

### Extra Buttons

Now that you know where your main workspace and hub are located, there are also a few other buttons in Infinite Craft you may have seen. On the bottom of the screen in your workspace (left side of the screen) there are four icons located in the lower right-hand corner: a Trashcan, a Moon, a Broom, and a Volume Button.

-   The **Trashcan** will allow you to delete multiple items within the hub on the right side of the screen, allowing you to clean up your space and start with a fresh slate to focus on items that you have not discovered yet.

-   The **Moon** will turn on Night Mode and change the look of Infinite Craft to appear more eye-friendly by dawning a darker tone for those who would prefer a dark background.

-   The **Broom** will clear off all of your current items in your workspace, cleaning up anything you were working on and giving you a fresh new page to start a new thread of discoveries to be made.

-   The **Megaphone** allows you to mute and unmute the notification sounds within Infinite Craft. Often the pings will let you know when you discovered a new item for your collection versus when you make a First Discovery.

To learn more about [First Discoveries](/wikis/infinite-craft/What_First_Discovery_Means "What First Discovery Means"), be sure to check out our IGN Guide to get a better idea of how to unlock a First Discovery on your own!
